evidence.summary: The card's own credit terms: 300 travel credit per cardmember year, resetting on the account anniversary; curated hotel credit 500 per calendar year, 250 per booking, two-night minimum; dining credit 150 per half year; ride credit 10 per month through September 30, 2027; trusted-traveler fee credit 120 every four years from the last use; streaming credit 20 per quarter with carry-over up to 20; and a choice between a 200 yearly lifestyle credit and a 25 monthly wellness credit.
evidence.title: Northwind Voyager statement credit terms

restrictions: Prepaid bookings through the (invented) Northwind travel desk only
proposed_rule.summary: Up to 500 in statement credits each calendar year on prepaid stays of two nights or more at curated hotels, at most 250 per booking.
